translationRepairs: When Zhuangzong moved on Liu Shouguang, Siyuan and Li Sizhao took thirty thousand men out by Flying Fox, settled the country north of the passes, and seized Wu, Ji, and Ru.
When Zhuangzong moved on Liu Shouguang, Siyuan and Li Sizhao took thirty thousand men out by Flying Fox, settled the country north of the passes, and seized Wu, Gui, and Ru.
媯州 is Gui Prefecture. Ji is a misreading of the place name.
Zhuangzong attacked Liu Shouguang. Siyuan and Li Sizhao led thirty thousand men separately out through Flying Fox, pacified the lands beyond the passes, and took Wu, Ji, and Ru prefectures.
Zhuangzong attacked Liu Shouguang. Siyuan and Li Sizhao led thirty thousand men separately out through Flying Fox, pacified the lands beyond the passes, and took Wu, Gui, and Ru prefectures.
The literal field repeats the same incorrect reading of 媯 as Ji.
He seized the cup and drained it, brandished his weapon, charged into their White Horse troops, and came back with two deputy commanders in his grasp.
Siyuan seized the cup and drained it, brandished his weapon, charged into their White Horse troops, and came back with two deputy commanders in his grasp.
The continuing subject is Siyuan, who has just volunteered to charge the White Horse troops; naming him removes a real ambiguity after Zhuangzong's speech.
Wang Yanzhang hammered Yan. Zhuangzong marched out in full force. Siyuan led the van and hit Liang.
Wang Yanzhang hammered Yun Prefecture. Zhuangzong marched out in full force. Siyuan led the van and hit Liang.
The proposal correctly expands the prefecture name but preserves the existing misreading. 鄆 is Yun, not Yan.
That month Zhang Juhun left office.
That month Zhang Juhan left office.
張居翰 is Zhang Juhan; Juhun is a romanization error.

On guihai Feng Dao, Bright Hall academician and vice minister of war, and Cui Xie, grand master of splendid happiness, became vice directors of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councilors.
On guihai Feng Dao, Bright Hall academician and vice minister of war, and Cui Xie, chamberlain for ceremonials, became vice directors of the Department of State Affairs and co-grand councilors.
太常卿 is the Chamberlain for Ceremonials. 'Grand master of splendid happiness' is not this office.
On jiazi of the seventh month Fang Ye of the west, prefect of Sui, seized Kui, Zhong, and Wan.
On jiazi of the seventh month Xifang Ye, prefect of Sui, seized Kui, Zhong, and Wan.
西方 is the compound surname Xifang in the attested personal name Xifang Ye, not a directional modifier.
On yiyou envoys arrived from Zangge and from Kunming.
On yiyou, Song Chaohua, envoy from Zangge, arrived together with envoys from Kunming.
The source explicitly names Song Chaohua as Zangge's envoy. The revision restores the omitted name with clearer English syntax.
On bingchen prisoners in the capital were amnestied.
On bingshen prisoners in the capital were amnestied.
丙申 is bingshen. Bingchen would be 丙辰.
In the tenth month of winter Li Jingzhou, military governor of Jingnan, marched against him.
In the tenth month of winter, Li Jingzhou, military governor of Jingnan Circuit, the former Binning Circuit, marched against him.
靜難軍 is the northern Jingnan Circuit, renamed from Binning, not the southern Jingnan polity written 荊南. The revision disambiguates it without inserting Chinese into the English prose.
On wushen Wang Chuanji, a Haizhou officer, killed the prefect Chen Xuan, had thrown in with Wu, and now came over in surrender.
On wushen, Wang Chuanji, an officer of Hai Prefecture, killed its prefect Chen Xuan, rebelled against Wu, and came over in surrender.
叛於吳來降 says that Wang Chuanji rebelled against Wu and then surrendered to Later Tang. The proposal reverses his relationship to Wu.
The Tatar leader Ge led his people in submission.
The Tatar leader Xiege led his people in submission.
頡哥 represents the full name Xiege. Rendering only the final syllable as Ge truncates the name.
In the third year, spring, on gengzi of the first month, the Khitan envoy Zhuaiyu came.
In the third year, spring, on gengzi of the first month, the Khitan envoy Zhuaigu came.
The extracted pinyin Zhuàigǔ confirms that 拽骨 should be represented as Zhuaigu, not Zhuaiyu.
Congrong’s revolt, the deaths of Ren Yuan and An Chonghui—these were precisely superiors and subordinates shielding one another, and praise and blame twisting what was true.
Congrong’s revolt, the deaths of Ren Huan and An Chonghui—these were precisely superiors and subordinates shielding one another, and praise and blame twisting what was true.
任圜 is Ren Huan. Ren Yuan is a romanization error repeated in both translation fields and the extracted name claim.
